_comment: Which of the six Form I babs a p~q vowel code names, and its display name. p is the past vowel, q the present vowel, read off Wiktionary's ar-verb template (I/a~u etc).
_form_keys: Wiktionary spells the two quadriliteral forms lowercase; patterns.json keys them uppercase. Only the forms that differ need an entry.
_sources: Where a verb's bab can come from. Every source in this order is tried and every one that answers is shown, so a reader sees both books when both name one.
